technical.summary: Short-term momentum signals (Hull, three white soldiers, DC10 breakout) show bullish structure, but price remains below key moving averages (50/200) with weak trend strength (ADX 20.35) and overbought RSI-9 limiting conviction.

fundamental.summary: CDW shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 19 days creating elevated event risk.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — large amounts but trades 106-175 days old
sentiment.summary: Moderate buy signal driven by fear-zone contrarian opportunity and stale congressional purchases; limited conviction due to age of trades and absence of recent news confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: crisis VIX (344.6), flat yield curve, rising dollar, recent CPI miss, and earnings binary in 19 days create elevated risk for IT sector.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull flip, three white soldiers, and DC10 new high show short-term momentum structure with price near support (148.85), offering a defined risk entry in a fear-zone contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, unfavorable yield curve, rising dollar), high earnings risk in 19 days, price below both 50/200 MAs, weak ADX trend confirmation, and overbought RSI-9 create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Hull flip and three white soldiers provide short-term momentum structure at support, and fear-zone contrarian sentiment offers tactical opportunity. However, macro severity, earnings binary risk, and technical weakness below key MAs create asymmetric downside that outweighs entry quality.
decision.primary_risk: Earnings announcement in 19 days combined with crisis VIX (344.6), unfavorable macro (flat yield curve, rising dollar), and price below 50/200 MAs create binary event risk with limited upside confirmation.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents show buy signals, but fundamental and risk agents strongly oppose; debate decisively favors bear case.
decision.portfolio_note: Already 18 positions in Information Technology sector; adding CDW increases concentration risk in high-volatility sector during macro stress without sufficient conviction to justify additional IT exposure.
